bridge-type.label: Bosch Smart Home Camera Account
bridge-type.description: A Bosch SingleKey ID account the cameras are registered with. Has a channel group with the notifications of every camera of the account.

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Interval the account is polled in sec. Only picks up what is changed in the Bosch Smart Camera app, such as the notifications; commands from openHAB are read back right away.

thing-type.label: Bosch Smart Home Camera
thing-type.description: A Bosch Smart Home Camera of the second generation, talked to directly through its local API. Put it under an account to switch its privacy mode.

parameter.name: host
parameter.label: Host
parameter.description: Address of the camera in the local network.

parameter.name: user
parameter.label: User
parameter.description: User of the local API. The Bosch Smart Camera app shows it once the local data interface is enabled (camera settings, More, Local Data Interface).

parameter.name: password
parameter.label: Password
parameter.description: Password of the local API, shown in the Bosch Smart Camera app next to the user.

parameter.name: snapshotCacheSeconds
parameter.label: Snapshot Cache
parameter.description: How long a fetched image is reused before the camera is asked again. The number of viewers does not matter, they all share it.

parameter.name: publishEventsApi
parameter.label: Publish Events as API
parameter.description: Offer the events the Bosch cloud keeps for this camera, with their images and clips, as JSON at the address in the eventsApiUrl property. Like the snapshot it is guarded by the token in the address and the networks of the binding. Needs an account.

parameter.name: trustAllCertificates
parameter.label: Trust All Certificates
parameter.description: Accept any certificate instead of only those issued below the root Bosch publishes for the local API. Only meant as a way out should a firmware update bring a new root, the camera is not verified then.

channel-group-type.label: Camera
channel-group-type.description: What the camera reports itself, available without an account.

channel-group-type.label: Cloud
channel-group-type.description: What the Bosch cloud keeps of the events of the camera. Needs an account.

channel-group-type.label: App Push Notifications
channel-group-type.description: Push notifications of one camera to the Bosch Smart Camera app on the phones of this account.

channel-type.label: Privacy Mode
channel-type.description: ON puts the camera into privacy mode: it stops watching and recording, the Eyes Indoor Camera II also lowers its lens into the housing, so it cannot see at all. The state is read from the camera itself and works without an account. Switching needs the camera under an authorized account: the local API can only read the privacy mode, so openHAB switches it through the Bosch cloud. Without an account a command is ignored and the switch returns to what the camera reports.

channel-type.label: Event
channel-type.description: Fires once per event the camera detects, with its kind as payload.

channel-type.label: Last Event
channel-type.description: Kind of the event the camera detected last.

channel-type.label: Last Event Time
channel-type.description: When the camera detected the last event.

channel-type.label: Recording
channel-type.description: ON while the camera records a clip of an event.

channel-type.label: Snapshot URL
channel-type.description: Address a still image of this camera can be fetched from. Contains a token, so treat it as a secret. The image is only offered while this channel is linked to an item.

channel-type.label: RTSP URL
channel-type.description: Address of the stream through openHAB as plain RTSP, without TLS and without password: the token in the address stands in for it, so treat it as a secret. Only set when the RTSP port of the binding is configured. Plain streams are only offered while this or the RTSP substream URL is linked to an item.

channel-type.label: RTSP Substream URL
channel-type.description: Like the RTSP URL, but the small stream without sound (704×400), the one a video recorder detects motion on. Contains the token, so treat it as a secret.

channel-type.label: RTSPS URL
channel-type.description: Address of the stream through openHAB over TLS, without password: the token in the address stands in for it, so treat it as a secret. openHAB shows the certificate it serves HTTPS with, see the thing properties. Only set when the RTSP port of the binding is configured. Streams over TLS are only offered while this or the RTSPS substream URL is linked to an item.

channel-type.label: RTSPS Substream URL
channel-type.description: Like the RTSPS URL, but the small stream without sound (704×400). Contains the token, so treat it as a secret.

channel-type.label: Camera RTSPS URL (direct)
channel-type.description: Address of the stream directly at the camera, with TLS. The player has to accept a certificate that names the MAC address of the camera instead of its host, and logs in with the user and password of the camera.

channel-type.label: Last Clip Snapshot URL
channel-type.description: Address of the still image of the last clip, as the cloud keeps it, served through openHAB. Contains the token, so treat it as a secret. Only offered while this channel is linked to an item.

channel-type.label: Last Clip URL
channel-type.description: Address of the video clip of the last event, served through openHAB once the camera has uploaded it. Contains the token, so treat it as a secret. Only offered while this channel is linked to an item.

channel-type.label: Clip Ready
channel-type.description: Fires when the clip of an event is in the cloud, with the kind of the event as payload.

channel-type.label: App Push Notifications
channel-type.description: Whether the Bosch Smart Camera app sends push notifications for this camera to the phones of this account. ON follows the schedule set in the app. A change made in the app shows up with the next poll of the account.

channel-type.label: App Push Status
channel-type.description: The push setting as the Bosch cloud reports it, e.g. ON_CAMERA_SCHEDULE after switching on in openHAB, OFF_OVERRIDE after switching off, or ALWAYS_OFF. Everything starting with OFF means no push notifications.
